text_block_list.text:
We arrived in Fukushima, the host of the Radio NIKKEI Sho.
Twin Turbo's beloved stomping ground.

In the days leading up to the race, Twin Turbo ran around
tourist spots to her heart's content, and what's more—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this famous extra-thick yakisoba
is delicious! And the peaches too!

The food must have suited her taste,
as she devoured it with gusto.
And then came—the day of the race.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Turbo's engine feels totally full today!
choice_data_list: Yeah, your muscle tone has really bounced back!
Yeah, your muscle tone has really bounced back!

text_block_list.text:
Because Twin Turbo is small and burns through every ounce
of her energy when she runs, she was prone to losing weight.
However—
Coming to Fukushima seems to have greatly aided her recovery. It appears she suits not just the track, but the land itself.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm off!
Turbo full throttle--!!

"The question is whether you can learn something from the race.
Yes—"

A graded race held on a tight-turning, flat track.
Will she be able to navigate
these unique conditions successfully?
